articles.summary: We are pleased to welcome Amanda van Dyke to our Board of Advisors, bringing with her deep expertise at the intersection of investment, mining, and critical minerals. A senior investment professional, Amanda has a rare blend of private equity, public equity, and capital markets experience, with a particular focus on junior mining companies
